notes: The mesh encodes the 1x rectangular tank and still-water fill level.
The published roll-angle history and pressure records are external benchmark data.
The pressure_gauge entry is an initial-condition diagnostic sample, not an algebraic pressure constraint; pressure history comparisons use pressure_sensor.
The face files are disjoint (every face vertex on the wall).  The June deck's face files overlapped at the tank edges between no-slip walls, so the relabeling changes no condition.
Level set: harmonic PDE velocity extension, monolithic (D55), with kinematic reconciliation (D14) and sign-definite patch bounds (D21).
The roll forcing (body force and rotating-frame angular velocity tables under bc/) is derived from the published motion record by generate_spheric_test10_roll_body_force.py; it is not committed.

qualification_criteria.completion_justification: past the June stop at 0.89-0.90 s (line-search trial cut fractions near 1e-8) and the first Sensor1 impact peak at 0.953 s
qualification_criteria.reported: Sensor1 RMS difference over 0-1.4 s; the 7.3 s peak (tracker M6); volume drift
qualification_criteria.sensor1_first_peak_justification: the fitted 2D deck is 12% low (3.38 mbar); 30% leaves room for this coarse 3D mesh (h = 45 mm) and still rejects the June accepted pressures of about 2-3 times the reference
qualification_criteria.sensor1_first_peak_time_justification: about 5% of the time to the first impact; the fitted 2D MeshNitsche deck peaks 0.028 s early (0.925 s), so the unfitted deck is held to the same order
qualification_criteria.status: proposal (D1): the working criteria of the SPHERIC campaign until the user sets tolerances
